gloss: my home; my place; my family

definitions.gloss: my home; my place; my house; my family
definitions.explanation: A colloquial word for one's own home or household. Refers to the speaker's residence or family group, and is the everyday spoken counterpart to {家|いえ}.

examples.japanese: うち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧。
examples.english: My place is close to the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Come over to my place next time.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サラリーマン→サラリーマン：06084_sarariiman⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father is an office worker, and my mother is a nurse.

notes:
Colloquial spoken word for one's own home or family. Almost always written in hiragana when used in this sense. うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun is the common pattern for referring to a family member or something belonging to one's household.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to go home
- うち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat at home
- うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: my child / our kid
- うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: my company / our company
- うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧: our dog

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: house — refers to the building itself; more neutral
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧: one's own home — formal/written register
- ⟦{内|うち}→内：01328_uchi⟧: inside, within — different word entirely; separate entry
